title: SQL Business Analysis
description: Sample SQL case study demonstrating how queries can be used to summarize transactions and answer practical business questions.
objective: Demonstrate core SQL analysis techniques for extracting, filtering, aggregating and joining structured business data.
steps: Reviewed the database structure and identified relevant tables and fields.
Used filtering to isolate records relevant to specific business questions.
Applied aggregation functions to summarize transaction data.
Used joins to combine related information across tables.
Reviewed query results and translated them into concise business observations.
results: Produced a sample SQL analysis workflow covering filtering, aggregation and joins to answer practical business questions.
